run_type: Two descriptive whole-Cargo pilots, with reversed source-compiler order on separate hosted boots.
readout: Compare all four complete retired-instruction measurements, the complete kernel-observed compiler work inventory, fresh and warm diagnostics, selected public metadata and invalid/repair controls.

Only advance to six independent paired hosts for a performance claim if both arms validate, at least one actual indirect compiler is eliminated on both boots and the whole edited check costs at least 10 percent fewer instructions on each boot. Otherwise report the measured mechanism and cost.

The stronger goal is 20 percent fewer complete edited instructions, with 2x a separate comparison and no inference from invocation counts. Report cold, first unchanged, and any logical or physical metadata differences.
A signed baseline differs from these source-built arms. Use within-boot P/C comparisons and report the parent direct/indirect counts even if they differ from signed -22.
